name: io.github.pdhimal1/eli5-park
title: ELI5 Park adventures
description: Big ideas, made small — free explainers for kids on science, money, careers, cooking and more.

tools.name: search_adventures
tools.description: Finds the ELI5 Park adventures that best match a question or topic. Returns each adventure's id, title, section and page link. Kid adventures by default; grown-up guides need audience=grownups. Read a result in full with read_adventure.

query.description: The question or topic, in plain words.

category.description: Optional: only adventures in this section, e.g. 'Artificial Intelligence' or 'ai'.

audience.description: Kid adventures by default. Use grownups for NCLEX, money planning and coding interviews; all for both.

tools.name: read_adventure
tools.description: Reads one adventure in full, as plain text, by its id (e.g. ai/ai). Use the id from search_adventures or list_adventures.

tools.name: list_adventures
tools.description: Lists every adventure (id, title, link), grouped by section: Artificial Intelligence, Technology, Money, Careers, Body & Mind, Medical, Cooking, Science and more. Kid adventures by default; grown-up guides need audience=grownups.

category.description: Optional: one section only, e.g. 'Cooking' or 'cooking'.

audience.description: Kid adventures by default. Use grownups for the grown-up sections; all for both.
